title: Avro Lancaster ND820
memorial_details:
Rectangular brick pillar surmounted by a white cross, set on slabs and surrounded by posts and chain links . Dedicatory plaque placed on Face 1 with a smaller plaque above it depicting the squadron badge.

This memorial was commissioned by the Lincolnshire Aircraft Recovery Group.
inscription: +/ To the Glory of God/ and in honoured memory of/ (Names)/ Who lost their lives when Avro Lancaster (ND820) 635 Squadron/ crashed here while on a flight from RAF Downham Market/ Monday 10th April 1944/ Who now lie at rest in the surrounding fields./ Their names are commemorated on the/ Runnymede Memorial to the Missing./ Also in memory of crew member/ (Name) Buried in Stonefall Cemetery, Harrogate./ This memorial was commissioned by the/ Lincolnshire Aircraft Recovery Group.
